## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm lint`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm test`, `pnpm check:package` and `pnpm check:readme` pass
- [ ] Tests added or updated beside the changed source (`*.test.ts`)
- [ ] A changeset (`pnpm changeset`) for any user-facing change
- [ ] If a validation check is relaxed: a test shows the attack it blocked is still refused, and the reason is explained above
